plainTranslation: Uranus disrupts your presence through others, sudden changes via relationships and people who shake up how you see yourself. Stay open to the jolt without letting others detonate your identity.
policy: Transit-to-natal entries are ordered: transiting planet to natal point. Do not apply same-moment aspect exclusions. Interpret as an active pressure or opening, not a guaranteed event.
